english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 English required (TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS 6.0, or Cambridge B2 First/FCE); exempt if currently studying in English at home university (confirm RHET 1020 / English-medium confirmation letter).

host_language_requirement.value: B2 Italian required for Italian-taught Academic Curriculum courses (otherwise recommended pre-session/semester Italian course); no Italian required for English-taught International Curriculum.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Catholic University of the Sacred Heart (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore)/2025-2026/UCSC IIS Spring 2026_all partners MILAN campus.pdf#page=2

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026 Fall: Classes start Sep 15, 2025; Exams Jan 7-Feb 21, 2026.
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Catholic University of the Sacred Heart (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore)/2025-2026/UCSC IIS Spring 2026_all partners MILAN campus.pdf#page=3

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026 Spring: Classes start Feb 23, 2026 (Economics Trimester begins Jan 7, 2026); Exams Jun 1-Jul 25, 2026.
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Catholic University of the Sacred Heart (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore)/2025-2026/UCSC IIS Spring 2026_all partners MILAN campus.pdf#page=3
spring_term_dates.notes: Dates from p.3-4; Faculty of Economics runs on a trimester calendar.

tuition_model.notes: Exchange students remain enrolled and pay tuition to home institution; UCSC tuition waived (fee-paying Study Abroad is a separate track).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: UCSC Milan accommodation/living guide estimates EUR 1,500-2,200/month total (accommodation EUR 4,500-6,000/sem, food EUR 2,000-3,000/sem, leisure EUR 1,500-2,500/sem, transport ~EUR 135/sem, books ~EUR 300/sem).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate from EUR 1,500-2,200/month (EUR 1,850/mo) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); math: 1,850 * 5 * 1.1052 = 10,223.10 USD (approx. USD 10,223).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory EUR 80 enrolment fee (includes Student Safety Package health/liability insurance); EUR 45 activity fee for International Curriculum courses; pre-session or semester Italian language course EUR 400 each (EUR 600 combo); non-EU students must obtain International Health Insurance.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Catholic University of the Sacred Heart (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore)/2025-2026/UCSC IIS Spring 2026_all partners MILAN campus.pdf#page=6

housing_availability.notes: MIL Service coordinates off-campus shared apartments on a first-come, first-served basis unless guaranteed by specific partner agreement.

housing_notes.value: Off-campus shared apartments coordinated via MIL Service (first-come, first-served); accommodation budget EUR 4,500-6,000/semester per UCSC living guide.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Catholic University of the Sacred Heart (Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore)/2025-2026/UCSC IIS Spring 2026_all partners MILAN campus.pdf#page=7

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No UCSC incoming exchange stipend published; official UCSC grants target outgoing UCSC students.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students require an Italian Type D study visa via Universitaly, valid International Health Insurance, and post-arrival Codice Fiscale; exact lead time and financial proof thresholds vary by consulate.
